mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 54 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, plus a waxing crescent moon. Also, the International Space Station will pass overhead later, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona reminds residents that polling locations were recently updated, so please verify your ward and assigned polling place at the My Vote Wisconsin website before election day. Polls will be open from 7 AM to 8 PM.

There is plenty to do around town, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, ART House 360 Thursday nights today, and Hop Haus Trivia today at 6:30 PM. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on October 5, officers were dispatched to USH 18/151 for a single-vehicle motorcycle crash where the rider was transported to a local hospital.
Today's flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
